ability.lensouls.weakness_lens.name: Weakness Lens
ability.lensouls.spatial_warp.name: Spatial Warp
ability.lensouls.temporal_recall.name: Temporal Recall
ability.lensouls.time_stop.name: Time Stop
ability.lensouls.vital_strike.name: Vital Strike
ability.lensouls.weakness_lens.descripti: §aTake photos with a Soul Photography enchanted camera. The resulting photo can be mounted on an enchanted sword's slot to deal bonus damage against the entity type captured in the frame.
ability.lensouls.spatial_warp.descriptio: §aInjects the capture location into the photo. Left-click air with the photo to consume it and create a spatial warp zone centered at that location, allowing ranged interaction with blocks and entities within the zone. Deactivates on dimension change or ability switch.
ability.lensouls.temporal_recall.descrip: §aInjects a health and position snapshot into the photo. A lethal hit automatically consumes one recall photo to save you. Can also be triggered manually by left-clicking air with the photo.
ability.lensouls.time_stop.description: §aRight-click with a Soul Photography enchanted camera to freeze all visible entities for 5 seconds. You are unaffected.
ability.lensouls.vital_strike.descriptio: §aRight-click with the camera without consuming film or producing a photo. Deals 1 toughness damage to the targeted boss. Requires Soul Photography enchantment.
ability.lensouls.soul_sever.name: Soul Sever
ability.lensouls.soul_sever.description: §aRight-click with viewfinder open: 30%% chance to deal 10-20%% current HP damage (bypasses all restrictions). Shockwave FX on success, fail sound on miss. Cooldown: 10s (success) / 0.5s (failure). No film consumed.
ability.lensouls.ability_steal.name: Ability Steal
ability.lensouls.ability_steal.descripti: §aTake a photo to capture entity data. The resulting photo can be equipped in the Photograph curio slot for element infusion or special effects. See JEI for details per entity.
lensouls.configuration.toughnessDefaultH: Default photos needed to break toughness. Can be overridden per entity below
lensouls.configuration.toughnessHitsOver: Per-entity override: "modid:entityid:count". Click + to add entries, e.g. "cataclysm:ignis:8"
lensouls.configuration.toughnessBlacklis: Entities NEVER trigger toughness. Click + to add, e.g. "minecraft:iron_golem"
lensouls.configuration.toughnessWhitelis: Entities ALWAYS trigger toughness. Click + to add, e.g. "cataclysm:ignis"
lensouls.configuration.enableBasicSoulDr: Mobs have a 10% chance to drop a random basic soul
lensouls.configuration.enableBossSoulDro: Bosses always drop their exclusive soul item
lensouls.configuration.enableEnchantment: Soul Photography book appears in dungeon chests and master librarian trades
lensouls.configuration.enableDimensional: Enable the Dimensional Gun crafting recipe
lensouls.configuration.enableGravityGunR: Enable the Gravity Gun crafting recipe
lensouls.configuration.enableSkillBallBo: Bosses have a 50% chance to drop a random Skill Ball

item.lensouls.copy_soul.desc: §aCrafting table: combine with any item — consumes this item, outputs an exact copy (enchantments/components/NBT preserved)
item.lensouls.feather_elementrise.desc1: §dA feather of elemental magic, but repels Copy Souls
item.lensouls.feather_elementrise.desc2: §eWorks when worn in any trinket slot, cannot be removed once equipped
item.lensouls.feather_elementrise.desc3: §cWhile worn: +60% damage taken, +75% damage dealt, permanent +2 potency to all potions; bosses drop no Copy Souls and Copy Souls cannot be used in crafting
item.lensouls.feather_twitcher.desc1: §dA feather entangled by a twisted fate
item.lensouls.feather_twitcher.desc2: §eWorks when worn in any trinket slot, cannot be removed once equipped
item.lensouls.feather_twitcher.desc3: §cWhile worn: +100% damage taken, -25% damage dealt. Twist starts at 0: +1 per Copy Soul consumed in crafting, real death +10, cap 100; higher twist increases damage dealt, up to +250%
item.lensouls.feather_twitcher.desc4: §cDying at 100 twist spawns a Twitcher (skipped if a Twitcher owned by you is alive within 32 blocks or a boss is within 64 blocks, twist stays 100; spawned -> twist resets to 0); that death ignores keepInventory protection
item.lensouls.feather_twitcher.desc5: §cTwist returns to 0 when the Twitcher dies
item.lensouls.feather_hardman.desc2: §eWorks in any curio slot. Cannot be removed once equipped
item.lensouls.feather_hardman.desc3: §cWhen worn: damage taken +75%, damage dealt +125%, base armor +10; lose all elemental affinity, potion activity has no effect, camera abilities fail, and Copy Souls cannot be used
item.lensouls.feather_hardman.desc4: §cAttacks have a 35% chance to inflict a random negative effect (level 1~20), lasting 5 seconds; every minute, you also receive a random negative effect lasting 10 seconds
message.lensouls.hardman.inject_fail: Huh, how does this thing work
